drifted.spec_says: io_queue_requests MUST be set to depth * 2
drifted.code_does: qpair.rs:173 sets io_queue_requests = depth * 4 for request splitting and burst absorption
drifted.recommendation: Update spec to depth * 4 with rationale

drifted.spec_says: Retry on ENOMEM for up to 50ms with poll-all-qpairs on each iteration
drifted.code_does: Retries for min(timeout_ms, 1000ms) via SUBMIT_ENOMEM_MAX_BACKPRESSURE_MS constant; dynamic cap adapts to operation timeout
drifted.recommendation: Update spec to reflect dynamic backpressure window

not_implemented.requirement: ContextPool slab allocator eliminating per-IO heap allocation
not_implemented.notes: ContextPool exists with acquire/release but allocates via Box::new() on pool miss. Pool starts empty and grows on demand rather than pre-allocating. Steady-state behavior eliminates allocation after warmup.

recommendations.description: Update io_queue_requests from depth*2 to depth*4 with rationale for request-splitting headroom
Update ENOMEM retry from fixed 50ms to dynamic min(op.timeout_ms, 1000ms)
Pre-allocate 340 context objects at actor construction to fully eliminate initial heap allocation
Add signal_stop() and detach_controller() to IBlockDeviceAdmin spec (FR-021)
Add fair polling rotation and per-client throttle as new FR (e.g., FR-026)
